title: Reverse engineering what makes a symbol memorable
authors: Brady R. T. Roberts, Wilma A. Bainbridge
venue: PNAS 123(10):e2530745123 (figure panels from the PsyArXiv preprint jbxdn, version 2, 2026)
caption_short: Left (Fig. 1A, Experiment 1): continuous recognition of conventional symbols, with fillers, a vigilance repeat a few trials later and a target repeat after about 1.25 min. Right (Fig. 2C, Experiment 2): encoding of 40 novel symbols with a word and a rating, a 2-min tone task, an 80-item old / new test and a cued-recall question.

The same panels appear as Fig. 1A and Fig. 2C in the published article (Europe PMC PMC12974420 figure captions checked). Experiment 2's cued recall of the word is not part of our build.
